_doc: Sun, sky, fog and post effects, aimed at Rust's daytime Launch Site look (hard warm sun, blue sky, pale dusty haze) and judged in Gauntlet rounds against Rust captures. Colours are linear RGB 0..1. 'tuned' says how each value was set.

rows.note: sun elevation in degrees (negative points down): a low afternoon sun that sits inside the 'sun' Gauntlet view and throws long shadows
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1 renders, by eye

rows.note: sun azimuth: 30 deg left of the 'sun' view (yaw 0), clear of the floodlight tower; behind-left of a player facing down the course, so ramps show a lit and a shaded face
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1 renders, by eye

rows.note: warm desert sun
direct sun strength
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye: 1.8 -> 2.1 with ambient_energy 1.2 -> 0.95 (critics: flat lighting, weak shadows; Rust's sun has harder contrast); 2026-10-08 by eye

rows.note: metres of directional shadow; the course is about 380 m long
rows.tuned: 2026-10-08 covers the course

rows.note: directional shadow filter softness (was a constant in Main.gd)
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b_1 site_overview render (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye: 0.35 -> 0.45 (acne lines on the lit ground); 2026-10-09 world_r1b renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye: 0.6 -> 0.35 (critics: soft, low-resolution shadows); 2026-10-08 by eye

rows.note: shadow depth bias (Godot default 0.1); lower keeps contact shadows attached
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b_1 site_overview render (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye: 0.05 -> 0.1 (with the tighter cascades and less blur, faint horizontal acne lines striped the sunlit ground); 2026-10-09 world_r2 renders, by eye

rows.note: shadow normal bias (Godot default 1.0); lower narrows the light leak where the two faces of a valley ramp meet
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r2 renders, by eye

rows.note: where the 2nd, 3rd and 4th shadow cascades start, as shares of shadow_distance (Godot default 0.1, 0.2, 0.5): the first cascade covers the nearest ~22 m so ramp edges, rails and the viewmodel's surroundings get crisp shadows
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye (critics: soft, low-resolution shadows)

rows.note: directional shadow atlas size in pixels, 16-bit depth (Godot's default size; kept for older GPUs: the player's 2021 AMD driver crashed once in 8 boots)
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye

rows.note: soft shadow filter quality for the sun, RenderingServer.ShadowQuality (0 hard .. 5 ultra; project default 2): 4 takes more filter taps so blurred edges stay smooth rather than banded
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1b renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 4), by eye

rows.note: elevation of the bounce fill in degrees, positive points up: light thrown back off the sunlit ground onto the faces the sun misses (opposite the sun azimuth, no shadow, no specular)
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r3 renders, by eye (a look, not measured from Rust)

rows.note: bounce fill colour: the warm dust of the lit plain

rows.note: bounce fill strength (the sun is sun_energy): shaded ramp faces keep their panels and cracks instead of going nearly black
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r3_18 start render (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.6 -> 0.75 (the shaded ramp face lost its slab and crack detail); 2026-10-09 world_r3_1x renders (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.8 -> 0.6 (shade reads as grey concrete in shadow, not lit brown); 2026-10-09 world_r3 renders, by eye (a look, not measured from Rust)

rows.note: DirectionalLight3D angular diameter in degrees: softens shadow edges with distance (the real sun is about 0.53)

rows.note: exponential fog per metre
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r3_14 renders (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.0008 -> 0.0006 (the horizon was still a milky band); 2026-10-09 world_r3_1x renders (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.0011 -> 0.0008 (r2 critics: a uniform grey band flattens the hills); 2026-10-09 world_r2 (gauntlet 2) renders, by eye: r1 critics: flat grey horizon strip, washed-out mid-ground (was 0.0016)

rows.note: how much the haze glows toward the sun
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1_n renders (gauntlet round 1, batch 3): 0.12 -> 0.06 (critics: the land washed out near the horizon under the sun), by eye; 2026-10-09 world_r3_16 sun render (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.2 -> 0.12 (0.2 washed the hills under the sun white); 2026-10-09 world_r3_1x renders (gauntlet 3), by eye: 0.05 -> 0.2 (haze glows toward the sun: sun-aligned in-scattering the critics asked for); 2026-10-09 world_r3: 0.1 still whitened the hills under the sun; world_r1: 0.25 washed the sky round the sun white

rows.note: how much the haze covers the sky itself near the horizon
